name: AlternativeTo
summary: Crowdsourced directory of 156,904 software titles with user-suggested alternatives, ranked by 2,047,652 user opinions.
description: A crowd-sourced, free site for finding alternatives to apps and services: 156,904 titles ranked by 2,047,652 user opinions, browsable by platform (Mac, Windows, Linux, web, iOS, Android …) and by tag. Each app page carries user reviews, likes, alternative links and platform/OS tags; the home page surfaces new releases, interesting new alternatives, community reviews and tech news. Signup is optional.
